This is included implementation work, not an existing live feature. Contact means using the submitted phone number; no claim of automatic bot messaging to customers who have not started the bot. Current live admin is a sandbox.

runs.text: User-specified fixed development price: USD 250, including the website, real admin/CRM integration, Telegram bot development, setup and go-live. The client pays domain and server/hosting provider charges separately, accounts and domain are registered under the business owner. Our work covers provider selection, registration assistance, connections and complete setup. First month after go-live includes free service/help and training of the designated person to maintain the website and use admin features. No subsequent monthly service price or provider fee was supplied, so none is invented here.
